items.rationale: Pat, Saltea and Pernă are familiar sleeping objects; Scaun is intended for sitting. Incidental sleeping in a chair does not change its normal function. No specialist or hidden sense is needed. Independent factual/recognition review, not a measured player-enjoyment study.

Făină, Mălai and Griș are cereal milling products; Drojdie is used for fermentation, not ground cereal. The ordinary ingredient senses distinguish the intruder, without falsely classifying every flour as wheat. Independent factual/recognition review, not a measured player-enjoyment study.

Cameră, Sufragerie and Dormitor denote interior rooms in the household context. Curte denotes the outdoor yard. Both dining-room and living-room uses of Sufragerie satisfy the same predicate, so its known ambiguity does not affect this board. Independent factual/recognition review, not a measured player-enjoyment study.

Caiet, Creion and Pix are school writing supplies; Examen is an assessment rather than a stationery object. A notebook supports writing even though it is not an instrument that deposits ink. Independent factual/recognition review, not a measured player-enjoyment study.

Homework is commonly written in a notebook; sleep provides rest for ordinary tiredness; pincers can remove a nail; sunflower seeds are a source of edible oil. The last claim does not say all oil is sunflower oil. These are direct, common task/tool/process relations. Independent factual/recognition review, not a measured player-enjoyment study.

Sprânceană is the hair arch at the lower forehead above the eye. A saucepan can be heated on a stove, goats eat grass as one of their foods, and a calendar represents calendar months. The labels avoid an exclusive diet or celestial-moon sense. Independent factual/recognition review, not a measured player-enjoyment study.

Opening and closing are opposites. Dr Oetker explicitly prepares vanilla custard for Cremșnit. A dish sponge washes a plate; fingers are terminal segments of a hand. The hand/finger pairing does not deny that toes also exist. Independent factual/recognition review, not a measured player-enjoyment study.

The mouth participates in speech articulation; powdered sugar is finely milled sugar; whey separates from milk after curdling, as DEX explicitly defines. A garden hose and watering can are both used to water plants. No claim of exclusive source or sole speech organ is made. Independent factual/recognition review, not a measured player-enjoyment study.
